mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 7.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment signals reduced labor market strength and dampened growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative during the trigger period, or UNRATE does not cross the 7.5% threshold within the specified timeframe.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in demand (GDPC1) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal expanding economic activity and accommodative monetary policy, amplifying equity valuations over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS movements, or 60-day returns not outperforming baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained FEDFUNDS rates below 2% signal persistent monetary easing, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain below 2% for the required period, or 60-day returns fail to exceed baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 98.5 signals weakening supply-side conditions, prompting central banks to raise rates and compress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 98.5 during the period, or 60-day returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (PAYEMS) and elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE) signal labor market weakness, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between PAYEMS and UNRATE movements, or 20-day returns do not decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising HOUST (housing demand) indicates expanding demand for housing, boosting economic activity and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not show upward trend in the 5-day window, or returns fail to follow within the timeframe (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a sharp decline in INDPRO below 98.0 triggers central bank rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not experience a significant decline during the period, or 20-day returns do not decline (t-test p > 0.05).
